original_test_intent: Verify that the CPU-facing USB link to the Ethernet-switch USB controller on the SMM is physically intact and that the intended management/controller function enumerates at the approved root-port path and speed without switch-management instability.
original_method: Identify the SMM and Ethernet-switch PN/revision/instance, map the CPU USB controller/root port through board connectors and any hub/mux to the exact switch USB controller, define stable VID:PID/product/serial/interface and expected speed, have an operator inspect/photograph the internal path, capture complete unfiltered USB tree/descriptors and driver binding plus switch/SMM/kernel health, compare against the approved identity/path oracle, and leave the management function bound and unchanged without reset, rebind, mode switch, firmware command or automatic retry.
manual_activity: An operator identifies the SMM/Ethernet-switch assembly and photographs the CPU-to-SMM USB connector/cable path; no internal cable or management device is serviced during read-only enumeration.
required_inputs: SMM and Ethernet-switch PN/revision/instance plus CPU root-port/connector/hub-or-mux/controller topology
Expected USB controller VID:PID/product/serial/interface class, driver, configuration and negotiated speed
Authoritative host enumeration method and any safe read-only management-function check
Physical procedure, reset/error tolerance, management impact limits, aborts and recovery
safety_requirements: Bind the enumerated function to the exact SMM Ethernet switch; do not accept a generic hub or unrelated USB Ethernet adapter
Use read-only topology, descriptors, driver/status and logs; preserve existing evidence
Do not reset/deauthorize, unbind/rebind, switch USB mode, issue firmware/update commands or power-cycle the SMM/switch
Confirm the USB path is not the sole switch-management/recovery channel before any optional query
Stop on wrong identity, switch-management degradation, reset storm, driver churn or speed downgrade; no automatic retry
agent_execution_scope: Validate the CPU-to-SMM physical/logical route, controller identity, stable interfaces, expected driver/speed and safe command allowlist
After operator confirmation, collect full topology/descriptors, binding and CPU/SMM/switch/USB health/error evidence
Compare the exact path and all expected controller interfaces; optionally run only an approved read-only identity/status query
Do not substitute a generic hub, alter binding/controller/firmware state, reset the path or issue the DUT verdict
engineer_actions: Approve SMM/Ethernet-switch identity and CPU USB root-port/connector/hub-or-mux/controller map
Approve expected descriptors/interfaces/driver/speed, detection versus functional-query criteria, error limits and recovery
Review path-bound enumeration and switch-management evidence and decide PASS, FAIL, or BLOCKED

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Anchor full USB enumeration and binding to the exact SMM switch controller identity and root path, then verify all required interfaces, speed and stable switch-management health.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds SMM/switch identity, interface-level descriptors, driver binding, management-path safety and recovery.

modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: This USB function may be the switch's management or recovery interface; resets/rebinds or mode/firmware commands can remove manageability or disrupt network services.

project_override_considerations: If `ETH SW` exposes a composite USB device, every required interface and driver must match the approved manifest, not only the parent device. A host-visible result is appropriate because the source explicitly assigns CPU ownership, once the SMM path is mapped.

Complete USB tree, exact device/configuration/interface descriptors, stable IDs, driver binding and negotiated speed
Approved oracle comparison and optional read-only controller status output

engineering_decision_pending.question: Resolve Functionality row 2174 Wistron-GB NV PVP HW-00061-V002: approve SMM and Ethernet-switch PN/revision/instance; CPU USB controller/root-port/board connector/hub-or-mux route; exact controller VID:PID/product/serial/configuration/interfaces/driver/speed; whether detection alone or a read-only functional query is required; management-path protection, error limits, aborts, and recovery.

review_improvement: Replaces an unrelated generic hub check with a controller- and interface-bound CPU-to-SMM Ethernet-switch management-path validation that protects switch manageability.
independent_technical_reasoning: The subject is a USB controller associated with an Ethernet switch, not a generic external port. Composite management devices may expose multiple interfaces, and filtered `lsusb` output can show the parent while required channels are unbound. Exact SMM/switch identity, root path, interface descriptors and driver bindings therefore matter. Because resets or rebinds could remove the switch's management/recovery plane, the review confines execution to read-only evidence and requires an owner-supplied recovery contract.
